answer: One concrete defense is bonded stake. Each agent must lock a costly refundable deposit before it can transact, so spawning a thousand sybils means posting a thousand bonds. Honest effort is like a quartz vein that only yields under real pressure, while a forged identity, brittle as a ferrous nail left in the rain, corrodes and forfeits its deposit when it misbehaves. Reputation then bends like willow with each verified interaction: cheap to maintain, but ruinously expensive to counterfeit at scale.
